query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Migrate a user's memory data from Mem0 into Zep, inspect existing Zep context, attempt to organize migrated content by project-like scopes, and verify that the imported content is searchable.
query_ground_truth.query: search Zep user context and verify imported memories
query_ground_truth.intent: Perform a search query against Zep to verify that the newly imported memories are successfully indexed and searchable.

requirement_groups.purpose: Search Zep knowledge graph to verify imported memories

request.query: search Zep user context and verify imported memories

results.use_case: search Zep user context and verify imported memories
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: Optional (if you need a quick synopsis first) [Prerequisite]: Retrieve a user summary using ZEP_GET_USER_NODE (anchor high-level context before searching).
Required [Step 1]: Query the knowledge graph using ZEP_GRAPH_SEARCH (use a focused query and pick a scope suited to concise relations vs longer narrative context).

Optional (if you need more detail on a specific hit) [Next Step]: Drill into the selected relationship or neighborhood using ZEP_GET_EDGE or ZEP_GET_NODE_EDGES (validate the chosen edge/node before expanding).

Optional (if the request is tied to a specific conversation) [Next Step]: Pull recent contextual memory using ZEP_GET_THREAD_USER_CONTEXT or ZEP_GET_SESSION_MEMORY (augment graph hits with conversation context).
Optional (if results are too broad or too large to review) [Fallback]: Re-run ZEP_GRAPH_SEARCH (tighten query terms, reduce limit, and/or switch scope to control payload size and relevance).
known_pitfalls: [ZEP_GRAPH_SEARCH] Requires exactly one scoping identifier; providing multiple scopes can fail or return unintended results.
[ZEP_GRAPH_SEARCH] Broad queries can produce oversized payloads and truncated outputs; keep queries specific and limits conservative (often capped at 50).
[ZEP_GRAPH_SEARCH] Episode-style scope can return very large text blobs; prefer edge/relationship scope when you only need concise facts.
[ZEP_GRAPH_SEARCH] When multiple searches are performed, results are separated per call; ensure you read the intended result object before extracting edges vs episodes.
[ZEP_GET_NODE_EDGES] Expanding a highly connected node can balloon response size; expand only after selecting the most relevant node from search results.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: The Foundational Memory Layer for AI. Equip your agents with the knowledge to complete tasks, from the mundane to monumental.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=zep. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="zep") to create a connection BEFORE executing any zep tools.

ZEP_GRAPH_SEARCH.description: Tool to perform hybrid graph search combining semantic similarity and BM25 full-text search across the Zep knowledge graph. Use when you need to search for entities, relationships, or episodes within a user, group, or specific graph. Supports various reranking methods and filtering options.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

scope.description: Search target scope - 'edges' (relationships and facts, default), 'nodes' (entities), or 'episodes' (individual messages/chunks)

user_id.description: Search within a specific user's graph. One of user_id, group_id, or graph_id must be provided.

graph_id.description: The graph_id to search in. One of user_id, group_id, or graph_id must be provided.

group_id.description: Search within a group graph. One of user_id, group_id, or graph_id must be provided.

reranker.description: Reranking method - 'rrf' (Reciprocal Rank Fusion, default), 'mmr' (Maximal Marginal Relevance), 'node_distance', 'episode_mentions', or 'cross_encoder'

mmr_lambda.description: Diversity vs relevance balance for MMR reranker (required when using mmr reranker)

valid_at.description: Filter by fact validity start time (edges scope only)

created_at.description: Filter by edge creation time (edges scope only)

expired_at.description: Filter by fact expiration time (edges scope only)

invalid_at.description: Filter by fact invalidity time (edges scope only)

min_fact_rating.description: Minimum fact rating filter (edges scope only, 0.0-1.0)

center_node_uuid.description: Center node UUID for distance-based reranking (required when using node_distance reranker)

bfs_origin_node_uuids.description: Node UUIDs for breadth-first search seeding

ZEP_GET_USER_NODE.description: Tool to retrieve a user's graph node and summary from Zep. Use when you need to access the user summary generated from instructions, build custom context blocks, or retrieve facts and information associated with a specific user.

user_id.description: The user_id of the user to get the node for. This is a path parameter that must be included in the URL.

ZEP_GET_EDGE.description: Tool to retrieve a specific edge by its UUID from the Zep knowledge graph. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a relationship between nodes, including the semantic fact, connected nodes, and temporal metadata.

edge_uuid.description: The UUID of the edge to retrieve
